game_concept: A puzzle set in Shadow Cave – Mushroom Cavern, a cavern of glowing mushrooms: the dwarf scout must handle zombies while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Digit Mill: Peel digits off a number with while n > 0 using // and %.
theme: Shadow Cave – Mushroom Cavern: a cavern of glowing mushrooms
core_gameplay_loop: In Mushroom Cavern, repeat each round: Peel digits off a number with while n > 0 using // and %. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the digits value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the supply cache using at most 10 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
win_condition: The supply cache reached with actions_used <= 10.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 10 before the supply cache is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 1 (intro tier): Digit Mill
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Digit Mill' (Week 4 slot 13), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Mushroom Cavern'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how digits changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against zombies in Mushroom Cavern.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The supply cache reached with actions_used <= 10.
